title: Mock module-level urlopen and sleep in remove_experimental_decorators tests
answers: how to test retries in remove_experimental_decorators without real network or delay
where to add tests for dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py
mock urlopen and sleep in dev script tests
test placement for dev scripts under tests/dev
body:
Convention: tests/dev/test_remove_experimental_decorators.py imports the script as `from dev import remove_experimental_decorators as module` and patches its module-level names with mock.patch.object(module, "urlopen", ...) and mock.patch.object(module, "sleep", ...).
This keeps retry tests offline and fast, and lets them assert the exact call count, the timeout=10 argument, and the sleep sequence (1, then 2).
When adding retry or status-code cases, patch urlopen and sleep the same way and make the mock raise HTTPError or URLError instances; assert call_count and sleep.call_args_list.
The PR's review thread shows 429/5xx and non-retryable 4xx paths were left without tests, so those branches have no coverage today.
applies: Tests for dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py only; the reviewer accepted leaving HTTP-status cases untested in this PR.

search: Tests in tests/dev/test_remove_experimental_decorators.py must patch module-level urlopen and sleep on dev.remove_experimental_decorators using mock.patch.object. This pattern keeps retry testing fast and offline while verifying timeout arguments, call counts, and sleep intervals. New tests should mock HTTPError or URLError, noting that 429, 5xx, and non-retryable 4xx branches currently lack test coverage.
